title: When both reasons apply the saved-lines reason shows
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders.
  • Have a new open work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with 2 part lines priced by tier A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  4. Point at Delete.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The page's menu shows Audit Log, Archive and a grayed Delete.

Step 4:

  • The tooltip reads tier A's name followed by "priced parts on 2 saved lines, so it can't be deleted. Archive it instead."
  • The open-work-orders text is not shown, though work order 1 is open.
  • The count 2 = the 2 part lines on work order 1.
